﻿Dr. Guillaume Dulude - Psychology Clipping
TikTok  |  Instagram Reels  |  YouTube Shorts
Launch date: Nov 20, 2026
✔ You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
⚠️ Audience Requirement: US, UK, and Australia
  WHAT TO DO
* Clip Dr. Guillaume Dulude talking about psychology and human behavior.
* Use his talks, interviews, podcast moments, and lessons.
* Each clip should teach one clear idea.
* Make viewers want to follow Guillaume for more.
* Post on TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts.
Content folder: 
https://f.io/3JvrlVwb
YouTube video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nFxbiWD0lpY
Podcast: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EeSQL7M7Ps0
	

Keep it professional and clean.
No memes, jokes, or humorous edits. Guillaume must be in every clip (on camera or speaking). Off-tone posts are rejected.
	

  CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
MUST INCLUDE
✔  Tag Guillaume using the handle for your platform
✔  A call to action to follow Guillaume for more
TikTok: @dr.guillaume.dulude
Instagram: @guillaume.dulude
YouTube Shorts: @DrGuillaumeDulude
	

YOUR CHOICE
* Everything else is up to you. Write your own caption around the required parts.
* Match the caption to what Guillaume says in the clip.
Example captions (Instagram handle shown. Use the handle for your platform.)
* Why some conversations click and others do not. Follow @guillaume.dulude for more.
	* Your attention changes how people feel around you. Follow @guillaume.dulude for more psychology.
	* A simple way to become a better listener. More from @guillaume.dulude on his page.
	* How fear of rejection shapes the way we talk. Follow @guillaume.dulude for more.
	

* Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
* Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
* Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
  ON-SCREEN TEXT (OPTIONAL)
* Add short text that matches what Guillaume says in the clip.
Examples:
* Why some conversations just click
* How to tell if someone is really listening
* The real reason we fear rejection
	

* Same rule as captions. Keep it genuine and true.
  EDITING GUIDELINES
* Background music: ALLOWED. Keep Guillaume's voice clearly audible. Music must not drown it out.
* No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
* Subtitles are recommended so viewers can follow without sound.
* Do not cut his words in a way that changes his meaning.
* Do not add logos or watermarks to the video.
  REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔  High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔  English content only
✔  Minimum video length: 10 seconds
✔  Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔  Minimum 0.50% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 5 likes)
✔  Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔  Audience: 50%+ from the US, UK, and Australia combined
✔  By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
  NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌  Memes, jokes, or humorous edits
❌  Clips without Guillaume in them
❌  Edits that change what Guillaume meant
❌  Logos or watermarks on screen
❌  Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌  NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌  Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌  Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌  Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌  False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌  Mislabeling the content (a talk is not "therapy")
❌  Music that drowns out the original audio
❌  AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌  Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌  Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌  Story boosting: story views do not count
❌  Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌  Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌  Removing the post before 30 days
❌  Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not the client. We are managing this campaign and are happy to help.
